title: ‘प्रदेश र पालिकामा रास्वपाको बहुमत निश्चित छ, कति सीट भन्ने मात्रै बाँकी हो’
content:
विराटनगर । निर्वाचन आयोग र सरकार स्थानीय तहको चुनावको तीव्र तयारीमा छ । योसँगै सत्तारुढ राष्ट्रिय स्वतन्त्र पार्टी (रास्वपा) भने चुनावी अभियानमा होमिएको होमिसकेको छ । निर्वाचनलाई ध्यानमा राखेर रास्वपाले उम्मेदवार बन्न चाहनेहरूका लागि ‘क्यान्डिडेट क्लब’ मा दर्ता हुन आह्वान गरेको छ । गाउँपालिका र नगरपालिकाका प्रमुख–उपप्रमुखसहित उम्मेदवार बन्न चाहनेहरूका लागि आवेदन खुलाएको रास्वपाले महानगर तथा उपमहानगरमा भने वडा तहका आकाङ्क्षीहरूका लागि आवेदन खोलेको छ । योसँगै रास्वपाले निर्वाचनकेन्द्रित विभिन्न अभियानहरूसमेत सञ्चालन गर्दै छ । भ्रातृ संस्थाबिनाको पार्टी बनाउने अभियानमा लागेको रास्वपाले विभिन्न विभागहरू गठन गरेर पार्टी परिचालन गरिरहेको छ । तर, कोशी प्रदेशको अधिवेशन सम्पन्न भएको लामो समय बित्दा पनि पार्टीले विभागहरू गठन गर्न सकेको छैन । पार्टीको आन्तरिक जीवन र आसन्न निर्वाचनका विषयमा राष्ट्रिय स्वतन्त्र पार्टीका कोशी प्रदेश सभापति चन्द्रबहादुर राई सँग गरिएको कुराकानीको अंश नेपाल टकमा- – सभापतिको अधिकार प्रयोग गरेर प्रदेश समितिमा मनोनीत गरिसक्नुभयो ? हाम्रो पार्टीमा बहुपदीय व्यवस्था छ । धेरै पदमा निर्वाचित भएर आउनुहुन्छ भने केही कार्यकारी पदलाई सहज र व्यवस्थित रूपमा सञ्चालन गर्न मनोनयन गर्ने व्यवस्था छ । हाम्रो विधान र कार्यविधिले नै प्रवक्ता र कोषाध्यक्ष मनोनीत गर्ने व्यवस्था गरेको छ । त्यहीअनुसार मैले पनि मनोनीत गरेँ । पुराना दलभन्दा रास्वपा लोकतान्त्रिक छ, तानाशाही होइन । विधि र प्रक्रियाले दिएको अधिकारबाहेक सबै पार्टी सदस्यलाई बैठकमा उपस्थित हुने, प्रस्ताव राख्ने र छलफल गर्ने बराबर अधिकार विधानमै उल्लेख छ । – प्रदेश अधिवेशनमा तपाईँको प्रतिस्पर्धी आज पनि सामाजिक सञ्जालमा ‘पार्टी विधि र प्रक्रियाबाट चलेन, फरक मत राख्नेलाई पाखा लगाइयो, गुटबन्दी गरेर जिताइयो’ भन्नुहुन्छ नि ? यो लोकतन्त्रको सुन्दर पक्ष हो । उहाँले पार्टी विधिअनुसार चलेन भनेर चिन्ता व्यक्त गर्न पाउनुहुन्छ, सचेत गराउने उहाँको अधिकार पनि हो । तर पार्टी लोकतान्त्रिक र विधिसम्मत तरिकाले चलेको छ, अधिवेशन पनि विधिबाटै सम्पन्न भएको हो र म निर्वाचित सभापति हुँ । अधिवेशनमा हामी चार जना सभापतिका आकाङ्क्षी थियौँ, ७६५ जना प्रतिनिधि हुनुहुन्थ्यो । कसलाई भोट दिने भन्ने अधिकार प्रतिनिधिहरूलाई थियो । कसैले ‘यी मान्छे राम्रा छन्, भोट दिनुपर्छ’ भनेर नाम सिफारिस गर्नुभयो होला, त्यसलाई गुटबन्दी भनिँदैन । हाम्रो पार्टीभित्र गुट छैन । – विभिन्न पार्टीबाट रास्वपामा कार्यकर्ता र शुभेच्छुक आइरहेका छन् । नेतृत्व गर्न कत्तिको गाह्रो छ ? कोही स्वार्थले पनि आएका होलान्, कसरी व्यवस्थापन गर्नुहुन्छ ? व्यवस्थापनमा केही चुनौती पक्कै छन्, तर बहुदलीय व्यवस्थामा विचार, सिद्धान्त र मुद्दा मिलेपछि अन्य दलबाट आउने–जाने क्रम चलिरहन्छ । थुप्रै नेता–कार्यकर्ता विचार र मुद्दा मिलेर आउनुभएको छ, उहाँहरूलाई हामीले स्वागत गरिरहेका छौँ । कोही स्वार्थले नै आएका होलान् कि भन्ने शङ्का रहे पनि बिनासर्त योगदान गर्न तयार छु भनेर आउनेलाई स्वागत गर्नुपर्छ । – पाार्टीका विभागहरूलाई अहिलेसम्म पनि पूर्णता दिनुभएको छैन नि ? यो पार्टीमा जनवर्गीय र भ्रातृ सङ्गठन छैनन् । आम नागरिकलाई पार्टीको झोले बनाउँदैनौँ भनेर हामीले भनेका छौँ । यो ‘क्याडर बेस्ड’ होइन, ‘मास बेस्ड’ पार्टी हो । विभाग गठनमा मान्छे नभएर समस्या भएको होइन । हामीलाई ५२ लाख जनमत आएको छ र ६ लाखभन्दा बढी सदस्य बनिसकेका छन् । १४ जिल्ला र १३७ पालिका रहेको कोशी प्रदेशका विविध जातजाति, भाषाभाषी र विज्ञता भएका साथीहरूमध्ये कसले कहाँ योगदान दिन सक्छ भनेर अध्ययन र छलफल गरिरहेका छौँ । योग्य र जान्नेलाई छान्नका लागि हामीले बायोडाटा पठाउन सार्वजनिक आह्वान पनि गरिसकेका छौँ, त्यसैका आधारमा छिट्टै विभाग गठन गर्छौँ । – स्थानीय तह चुनावको माहोल सुरु भइसकेको छ, तपाईंहरूले ‘क्यान्डिडेट क्लब’ खोलिसक्नुभएको छ । कोशीका १३७ पालिकामध्ये कति जित्नुहुन्छ ? फागुन २१ को जनमतले हामी जितिसकेका छौँ, अब कति धेरै जित्ने भन्ने बहस मात्र हो । यो पटक हामी बहुमत पालिकामा चुनाव जित्छौँ । अहिले सङ्घीय सरकारमा हामी छौँ । सरकारले कस्ता काम गर्छ र हामीले कति प्रयास गर्छौँ भन्ने कुराले पनि मत परिणाममा प्रभाव पार्छ । विगतको भन्दा राम्रो मत आउँछ । – सरकारका कामकारबाहीमा आलोचना बढिरहेको छ । ठिक ढङ्गले हिँडेको छ कि बाटो बिराएको जस्तो लाग्छ ? सुकुमबासी व्यवस्थापन हुन नसकेको कुरा पनि छ नि ? म खुलेर कुरा गर्ने मान्छे हुँ । पार्टीबाट निर्वाचित सांसदबाट बनेको सरकार पार्टीको विचार र नीतिविपरीत चल्न सक्दैन । अपेक्षाअनुसार शतप्रतिशत काम नभएको होला, त्यसमा संविधानका केही प्रावधान र राज्य संरचनाका बाधाहरू कारण छन् । तर ग्यारेन्टी के छ भने— पुराना दलको नेतृत्वमा बनेका सरकारले गर्न सक्ने काम पनि गरेनन् र गर्न नहुने काम बढी गरे । यो सरकारले त्यस्तो गर्दैन । भदौ २३ र २४ को ‘जेन-जी’ आन्दोलनअघिको सरकार हुँदा नदी किनारमा सामान्य पानी पर्दा पनि नागरिक डुबानमा परेका थिए, उद्धारमा समस्या देखिएको थियो । यो सरकार आएपछि ज्यान जोगाउन र व्यवस्थापन गर्न होल्डिङ सेन्टरको कुरा आयो । साथै यहाँको मात्र होइन, देशभरकै सुकुम्बासी र अव्यवस्थित बसोबासीको समस्या दीर्घकालीन रूपमा समाधान गर्न ऐन–कानुनमार्फत प्रक्रिया अगाडि बढाइएको छ । – प्रदेश सभामा रास्वपाको एजेन्डा के हो ? प्रदेश संरचना खारेज वा संशोधन गर्ने हो कि यही संरचनामा जाने ? हामीले पहिलेदेखि नै यो संरचनालाई पुनर्संरचना र संशोधन गर्नुपर्छ भन्ने एजेन्डा राख्दै आएका छौँ । अहिले प्रदेश सभा खर्चिलो र भद्दा भयो, नागरिकले अपेक्षाअनुसारको प्रतिफल पाएनन् भन्ने प्रश्न उठेको छ । यदि हामी संविधान संशोधन गर्ने तहमा पुग्यौँ भने प्रदेश संरचनालाई उपयोगी र कम खर्चिलो हुने गरी संशोधन गर्छौँ । साथै स्थानीय तहलाई दलरहित बनाउने परिकल्पना पनि हाम्रो विधानमा छ । – कोशी प्रदेशमा पहिचान र कोशी नामाङ्कनको मुद्दा जीवित छ । प्रदेश सभामा रास्वपाको बहुमत आयो भने नाम फेरिन्छ कि फेरिँदैन ? नाम फेरिन्छ भनेर म एक्लै भन्दिनँ । पहिचान संरक्षण गर्ने कुरामा रास्वपा स्पष्ट छ, तर नामाङ्कनको विषयमा सरोकारवाला पक्षसँग छलफल गरेर आम नागरिकको राय बुझ्नुपर्छ । आवश्यक परे जनमत सङ्ग्रह वा जनमतमार्फत जे आउँछ, त्यसैलाई स्वीकार गर्नुपर्छ । जनता जनार्दनको मतको हामी सम्मान र रक्षा गर्छौँ । – तपाईं आफैँ मुख्यमन्त्री वा सांसदको दौडमा हुनुहुन्छ कि हुनुहुन्न ? प्रदेश सभामा कति सिट आउँछ ? हिजो म प्रदेश सभापति हुन पनि पार्टीमा लागेको थिइनँ, अहिले पनि व्यक्तिगत पदको दौडमा छैन । तर पार्टीले निर्णय गरेर वा आवश्यकताले दिएको जुनसुकै जिम्मेवारी वहन गर्न म तयार छु, पछि हट्दिनँ । प्रदेश सभाको सीटको कुरा गर्दा गणितीय अङ्क त अहिले भन्न सकिँदैन, तर कोशी प्रदेशमा रास्वपाको बहुमत आउँछ । Biratnagar. The Election Commission and the government are in full swing preparing for the local level elections. Along with this, the ruling National Independent Party (NISP) has already embarked on the election campaign. Keeping the elections in mind, the NISP has called for those who want to become candidates to register with the 'Candidate Club'. The NISP has opened applications for those who want to become candidates, including the mayors and deputy mayors of rural municipalities and municipalities, and for ward-level aspirants in metropolitan and sub-metropolitan cities. Along with this, the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) is also conducting various election-focused campaigns. The RSSS, which is engaged in a campaign to form a party without fraternal organizations, is mobilizing the party by forming various departments. However, even after a long time has passed since the Koshi Province convention, the party has not been able to form departments. Nepal Talk has an excerpt from a conversation with Chandra Bahadur Rai, Koshi Province President of the National Independent Party, about the party's internal life and the upcoming elections. - Have you already nominated me to the provincial committee using the powers of the chairman? Our party has a multi-position system. If you are elected to multiple positions, there is a system of nominating some executive positions to run them smoothly and systematically. Our statute and working procedures have made provision for nominating a spokesperson and treasurer. I also nominated accordingly. Unlike the old parties, the RSVP is democratic, not authoritarian. Apart from the rights granted by law and procedure, the statute states that all party members have equal rights to attend meetings, submit proposals, and discuss. - Your competitor at the provincial convention is still saying on social media, 'The party did not follow the rules and procedures, those with different opinions were sidelined, and factions were formed to win'? This is the beautiful aspect of democracy. He has the right to express his concern that the party is not running according to the rules, and it is also his right to raise awareness. But the party is running in a democratic and legal manner, the convention was also held according to the rules, and I am the elected president. At the convention, we had four presidential aspirants, there were 765 delegates. The delegates had the right to vote for whom. Someone might have recommended a name saying, 'These people are good, they should be voted for,' but that is not called factionalism. There is no faction within our party. - Workers and well-wishers are coming to the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) from various parties. How difficult is it to lead? Some may have come for selfish reasons, how do you manage them? There are certainly some challenges in management, but in a multi-party system, once ideas, principles, and issues are aligned, there is a constant flow of people coming and going from other parties. Many leaders and activists have come with ideas and issues aligned, and we are welcoming them. Even if there is a suspicion that some have come out of self-interest, we should welcome those who come because they are ready to contribute unconditionally. - You still haven't completed the party departments, have you? There are no mass and fraternal organizations in this party. We have said that we will not make the common citizen the party's pawn. This is not a 'cadre-based', but a 'mass-based' party. The problem in forming the department is not due to lack of people. We have received 5.2 million votes and more than 600,000 members. We are studying and discussing who can contribute where among the diverse castes, languages, and expertise of the Koshi Province, which has 14 districts and 137 municipalities. We have also issued a public call for sending resumes to select those who are qualified and knowledgeable, and based on that, we will soon form the department. - The atmosphere for local elections has begun, you have already opened the 'Candidate Club'. How many of the 137 municipalities in Koshi will you win? We have already won the referendum on Falgun 21, now the only debate is how much more we will win. This time we will win the election in the majority municipality. Now we are in the federal government. What kind of work the government does and how much effort we put in also affects the vote result. The vote will be better than in the past. - Criticism is increasing over the government's actions. Do you think it is moving in the right direction or has it gone astray? There is also the issue of the lack of management of squatters? I am an outspoken person. A government formed by elected MPs from a party cannot operate against the party's ideas and policies. It may not have worked 100 percent as expected, due to some provisions of the constitution and obstacles in the state structure. But what is guaranteed is that the governments formed under the leadership of the old parties did not do what they could have done and did more than they should have done. This government will not do that. During the government before the 'Gen-G' movement of Bhadra 23 and 24, citizens were drowned even when there was normal water on the river banks, and there were problems in rescue. After this government came to power, the issue of holding centers came up to save lives and manage them. In addition, a process has been taken forward through laws to solve the problem of squatters and unorganized settlements not only here but also across the country in the long term. - What is the agenda of the RSVP in the provincial assembly? Should it abolish or amend the provincial structure or go with the same structure? We have been putting forward the agenda of restructuring and amending this structure for a long time. Now the provincial assembly has become expensive and clumsy, and the citizens have not received the expected results. If we reach the level of amending the constitution, we will amend the provincial structure to make it useful and less expensive. In addition, there is a concept in our statute to make the local level party-free. - The issue of identity and Koshi naming is alive in Koshi Province. Will the name change or not if the RSVP gains a majority in the provincial assembly? I am not the only one who says that the name will be changed. The Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) is clear about protecting identity, but the opinion of the common citizen should be understood by discussing the nomination with the stakeholders. If necessary, whatever comes through a public referendum or referendum, we should accept it. We respect and protect the opinion of the people. - Are you in the race for Chief Minister or MP yourself? How many seats will be available in the provincial assembly? Yesterday, I was not even in the party to become the provincial president, and I am not in the race for an individual post. But I am ready to shoulder any responsibility given by the party or by necessity, I will not back down. When it comes to the provincial assembly seats, the mathematical figures cannot be said now, but the RSVP will have a majority in Koshi province.
